items.title: Bitcoin hits $80.5K as US stocks rally on midterm election results
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed toward $80,500 as risk assets rallied on Democrats midterm election gains and oil prices fell.

items.title: Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
items.summary: The French bank said the attack allowed fraudulent operations but did not mention crypto, and is still assessing the amounts.

items.title: Circle reports $865 million in Q3 revenue and reserve income, discloses 5% workforce reduction
items.summary: Circle reported $865 million in third-quarter revenue and reserve income and disclosed cuts affecting approximately 5% of its workforce.

items.title: Binance stopped 57 North Korean cyber threats but fell for a fake job interview
items.summary: Binance said it thwarted 57 suspected North Korea-linked cyber threats in 2026, yet a fake interview compromised one of its engineers.

items.title: TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act Impossible
items.summary: The Democratic sweep and Sherrod Brown’s return may kill the CLARITY Act for two years.

items.title: THORChain's RUNE jumps 10% as North Korean hackers resume laundering Binance loot
items.summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor is routing Binance hack proceeds through THORChain.

items.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
items.summary: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.

items.title: Morgan Stanley among first banks to tokenize US equities, Treasurys through DTCC’s service
items.summary: Morgan Stanley said it converted US equities and Treasurys into tokenized form through DTCC's new tokenization service.

items.title: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
items.summary: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.

items.title: Schroders launches tokenized emerging markets debt fund on Solana with Centrifuge
items.summary: The $1 trillion-plus asset manager brings its emerging markets bond strategy to Solana, expanding the range of onchain actively managed funds.
